newsitem.title: USA: CSG Systems CFO Brenner to retire.
newsitem.headline: CSG Systems CFO Brenner to retire.

text.p: CSG Systems International Inc said its chief financial officer, David Brenner, is retiring effective March 31.

Brenner informed the company that because of a degenerative spinal condition he can no longer perform the duties of his position. The company said it is hopeful that Brenner will be available in a consulting capacity as his health permits.
CSG Systems said it named Greg Parker as its chief financial officer effective April 1. Parker has been with CSG since July, 1995 and currently holds the position of vice president of finance.
